source_verification_receipts.version: Econometric Theory First View, published online 23 July 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article fixes a prior on the reduced-form parameter and permits conditional priors subject to compatibility, then studies ex-ante and ex-post robust-Bayes games under that prior set.
The article studies asymmetric Type-I/Type-II regret and derives exact finite-sample solutions for normal, Bernoulli, and bounded-outcome experiments.
The paper optimizes over a simplex of mixtures among a finite number of decision rules and proves epsilon-minimax guarantees via mirror-subgradient/Hedge methods.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Christensen, Moon, and Schorfheide (2026) to the bibliography and state precisely why its profile-plus-average-risk target neither implies nor is implied by unrestricted signed-endpoint MMR.

Make the no-index witness question the sole headline deliverable by giving a small finite-support search family and a reproducible interval-arithmetic certificate script specification; retain the general trichotomy as a sequel-scale question.

For a stronger field contribution, prove a named application-to-game embedding or a verified inclusion from a published local-limit class into the compact polyhedral class, rather than relying chiefly on the custom overlap class.
